Question: Joe has a collection of \(23\) coins, consisting of \(5\)-cent coins, \(10\)-cent coins, and \(25\)-cent coins. He has \(3\) more \(10\)-cent coins than \(5\)-cent coins, and the total value of his collection is \(320\) cents. How many more \(25\)-cent coins does Joe have than \(5\)-cent coins?
